_about: PC-only deviations from the canonical Fire/Air numbers (docs/design/reconciled/data/arena/spells-*.csv and schools-combat.json, which carry VR's numbers). Keys: '<spellId>.<column>' (castS, cooldownS, mana, damage, telegraphS, rangeM) or '<school>.identity.<dotted key>'. Unknown keys fail at load. Parity suites run with ArenaState.balance = 'canonical', which ignores this file. Every key is a deviation and a CR candidate for VR (docs/concepts/W8-fire-air-dual-channel.md section 8). W8 lane B (2026-10-23): darts cut to the damage a VR seated dome lets through (PC has no dome) and halved in mana so the rivals can afford their kit; Air Form made free and quick, the only defence a rival plays while no AI reacts at pace 1.5. Evidence: docs/waves/W8-evidence/named.json.
